name: Z.ai API Platform
description: Serves Z.ai's GLM models through an HTTP API and official Python and Java SDKs, with function calling, web search, image and video generation, and document layout parsing.

skills.name: Function Calling
skills.description: Lets GLM models call developer-defined functions, with tool-call arguments streamed as they generate.

skills.name: Web Search
skills.description: Runs LLM-oriented web searches through the Web Search API and built-in tool.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Generates images from text prompts with GLM-Image, synchronously or as async jobs.

skills.name: Video Generation
skills.description: Generates video asynchronously with CogVideoX and returns results by task ID.

skills.name: Layout Parsing
skills.description: Parses document and image layouts and extracts text with GLM-OCR.
